meaning_phrase: Rừng đá hình thành do sự xói mòn đá vôi qua hàng triệu năm.

phrase: Frozen methane bubbles form when gas is trapped under ice in frozen lakes.

phrase: A light pillar is created when light reflects off ice crystals in the air.

phrase: A zebra rainbow appears when sunlight interacts with multiple layers of rain droplets.

phrase: Penitentes are tall thin ice spikes formed by sunlight melting snow unevenly.
